Кнопка «1x» в бою ускоряет схватку вдвое: The “1x” button in battle doubles the speed. Your choice is remembered.
Наёмники «Двух колоколов» ждут: зовите г: The Two Bells mercenaries are waiting: call heroes for scrolls and gems. Whoever doesn't come leaves a reward. Your first ×10 is sure to bring a blue hero.
В «Двух колоколах» полно бойцов без дела: The Two Bells is full of idle fighters. Hire the best — the road ahead is long.
Доход сундука за 2 часа — сразу, не дожи: 2 hours of chest income instantly, no waiting. Free once a day, then for gems.
Время — тоже добыча. Торопитесь? Заберит: Time is loot too. In a hurry? Claim some of the spoils right now.
Каждый день — простые задания. Выполняйт: Simple quests every day. Complete them, build up activity and collect gems and gold.
Решайте, как отряд поступит в пути. Выбе: Decide how the squad acts on the road. Pick a location and duration; the lineup affects event odds, your choices affect the loot.
В пути не только добыча: решайте, когда: The road holds more than loot: decide when to take a risk and whom to trust. Every fighter has their own talents.
Награды за вехи: этапы, уровни героев, п: Rewards for milestones: stages, hero levels, summons. Take a look — some are ready to claim.
Выбирайте путь и благословения, берегите: Choose your path and blessings, protect the squad. Wounds carry over between battles; every 10th floor is a boss. Defeat ends the run.
Перед боссом можно передохнуть. Подбирай: You can rest before the boss. Pick blessings that suit the squad and keep your fighters alive on the way to the top.
Соберите команду в матче из 7 раундов. Л: Build a team over a 7-round match. Shop, copies, training and synergies: campaign levels and gear give no edge here.
На арене побеждает подготовка команды. Д: In the arena, team prep wins. Give every companion a role and power up the squad at the right time.
Соберите отряд под слабость MVP. 2 попыт: Build a squad for the MVP's weakness. 2 attempts a day: rewards for damage thresholds, a card chance on victory. An Ult with a lightning mark breaks the charge.
Гильдия ждёт победы над MVP. Награда за: The guild awaits the MVP's defeat. Damage threshold rewards come even without a win — save your lightning Ult.
Каждый день новый товар: снаряжение, опы: New stock every day: gear, EXP, hero cards and scrolls. Pay with gold — now you have something to spend it on.
Cook one dish a day from ingredients. Until midnight the squad is stronger in the campaign, Tower and hunt; ingredients come from expeditions, hunts and the chest.
Из каналов все возвращаются голодными. Б: Everyone comes back from the culverts hungry. Bruno has fired up the kitchen at The Two Bells — eat before you go down.
Кузнец точит снаряжение за золото: +1 …: The blacksmith refines gear for gold: +1 … +10. A failure keeps the item and its level. Ore guarantees success.
Хороший клинок точат всю жизнь. Не жалей: A good blade is honed for a lifetime. Don't spare gold on the blacksmith — it comes back as victories.
